passages.locator: Fighting for Healthy Women and Families
passages.note: In October 1916 Margaret Sanger, Ethel Byrne and Fania Mindell operated a Brooklyn contraception clinic. The museum reports 488 women served over ten days before police closure; this is a reported count, not a population-level adoption estimate.
